name: Glaucoma Guardian
description: Open-angle, angle-closure, and secondary glaucomas — IOP, gonioscopy, visual fields, OCT RNFL, progression analysis, and medical, laser, and surgical management.

episodes.title: Glaucoma Defined: The Optic Neuropathy, Not the Pressure
episodes.description: Why IOP is a risk factor and not the diagnosis — reframing glaucoma for patients and practice.

episodes.title: Aqueous Dynamics: Production, Outflow, and the Uveoscleral Path
episodes.description: How aqueous is made and drained — the physiology that every glaucoma drug targets.

episodes.title: Intraocular Pressure: The Number and Its Fluctuations
episodes.description: Diurnal variation, the value of multiple readings, and why a single “normal” IOP can mislead.

episodes.title: Central Corneal Thickness: The Pachymetry Correction
episodes.description: How CCT changes the interpretation of IOP and the OHTS threshold that guides treatment.

episodes.title: Open-Angle vs Angle-Closure: The Gonioscopic Divide
episodes.description: Why every glaucoma suspect needs gonioscopy and the landmarks that classify the angle.

episodes.title: Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma: The Silent Thief
episodes.description: The natural history, the asymptomatic progression, and the optometric role in early detection.

episodes.title: Normal-Tension Glaucoma: When IOP Is Not the Whole Story
episodes.description: Vascular risk factors, the NTG phenotype, and the lower target pressures these patients need.

episodes.title: Ocular Hypertension: To Treat or Not to Treat
episodes.description: The OHTS risk calculator, the 5-year probability, and the shared decision-making conversation.

episodes.title: Primary Angle-Closure Suspect: Anatomy and Risk
episodes.description: Shallow chamber, plateau iris, and the laser peripheral iridotomy that prevents the acute attack.

episodes.title: Acute Angle Closure: The Emergency at Your Slit Lamp
episodes.description: The painful red eye, mid-dilated pupil, and the immediate pressure-lowering sequence that saves vision.

episodes.title: Secondary Glaucomas: PEX, Pigmentary, and Neovascular
episodes.description: Recognizing the secondary causes — pseudoexfoliation, pigment dispersion, and the ischemic NVG.

episodes.title: Pseudoexfoliation Syndrome: The White Flakes and the Pressure Spike
episodes.description: How PEX weakens the zonules, raises IOP, and changes cataract surgery risk.

episodes.title: Pigment Dispersion Syndrome: The Krukenberg Spindle
episodes.description: Midperipheral transillumination, the concave iris, and exercise-induced pigment release.

episodes.title: Neovascular Glaucoma: The Consequence of Ischemia
episodes.description: NVI on the pupillary margin, the CRVO and diabetes link, and the urgent anti-VEGF and tube pathway.

episodes.title: Steroid-Induced Glaucoma: The Pressure Response
episodes.description: Who responds, how quickly, and the topical steroid ladder that keeps patients safe.
